selection_rationale: Five modern international tournaments plus every Champions League final the provider publishes from 2009/2010 onwards. Every match from the quarter-final onwards is taken in full; the round-of-16 and group-stage samples are taken by combined goals, descending, earliest match date first, so the selection is reproducible and biased towards matches with the most attacking activity, which is what the activity index measures. Copa America 2024 is limited to the knockout rounds. The Champions League contributes the final of each published season because the provider publishes nothing else for that competition; the seasons 2019/2020 to 2023/2024 are not published at all. World Cups of 1958 to 1990 were imported earlier and are left out of the curated set for now; their payloads stay on disk and the corpus definition is the single place where they would be restored.
